scheme_name: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to one of the Denotified Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, or Semi‑Nomadic Tribes as notified by the Government of Rajasthan.
Applicant must be studying in class 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, or 11.
Applicant must be enrolled in a government or private educational institution/school affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer.
Applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the previous academic year.
Applicant must not have previously availed the benefit of this scheme.
Eligibility is limited to students from 32 specific communities (9 Denotified, 10 Nomadic, 13 Semi‑Nomadic) as per Government Order No. F-1(1)(2)S.W/63 dated 24.02.1964 Annexure ‘A’.
benefits_summary: Free bicycles are provided to eligible students in classes 6‑11 studying in government or recognized private schools.
